Dear Mrs. Wydra,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the incident. I have identified the issue. But the charger currently is in used condition. unfortunately we can´t perform any remote troubleshooting, when the charger is in operation. Let me know when the charger  will be free.
There is an update FW version ready to install. Please update the charger.  If you are unable to do it, let us know. We can update remotely.
It is always recommended that the charger should run with latest version of Firmware, in order to avoid any bug issue.
